title: Bug 660000: [64bit] Overflow in item application entry
summary: Variables in item application entry table are changed from int to bigint to prevent overflow in 64-bit calculations during cost processing.
key_points: Cost calculation optimization left some variables as int instead of bigint
5 variables corrected in both W1 and RU layers of Item Application Entry table
Prevents arithmetic overflow errors in 64-bit environments
Affects ledger entry calculations during item costing
quote: Some variables were declared as int instead of bigint.
